$comment: The single source of truth for Envy's user configuration. Read by the frontend (src/config.ts: defaults, validation, Settings bindings), by Rust (src-tauri/src/config.rs: `envynote config check`, startup keys), and by scripts/gen-skill-docs.mjs (the agent skill's reference tables). Add a setting here first; nothing else may invent a key.

keys.label: Notes folder
keys.doc: Where the notes live ("The Index"). A folder of plain .md files; created with a welcome note if it does not exist. Changing it here is the same as Settings → Change Location…

keys.label: Include notes in subfolders
keys.doc: Index .md files in subfolders of the vault, not just the top level. Templates/ and .trash/ are never notes either way.

keys.label: Date format
keys.doc: Pattern for the {{date}} placeholder when a note is created from a template. Unicode date-format tokens (yyyy, MM, dd, EEEE, MMMM, HH, mm).

keys.label: Empty trash every
keys.doc: How often the whole Trash is swept, as a count of `empty_unit`.

keys.label: Unit
keys.doc: The unit for `empty_every`.

keys.label: Return in the search box moves focus to the editor
keys.doc: With it off, Return opens the note but focus stays in the search box.

keys.label: Show note preview
keys.doc: A line of the note's body under each title in the list.

keys.label: Show date modified
keys.doc: The modified date column in the list.

keys.label: Date style
keys.doc: How the modified date is written: relative ("3 days ago"), smart (relative when recent, absolute otherwise), dateTime, or dateOnly.

keys.label: Row density
keys.doc: Vertical padding of list rows.

keys.label: Subfolder marker
keys.doc: How a note's subfolder shows in its row: a colored dot, the folder name as a chip, or nothing. Only matters with index.include_subfolders.

keys.label: Marker after the title
keys.doc: Put the subfolder marker after the title (true) or before it (false). The Inbox mark always leads.

keys.label: Show due dates
keys.doc: The due-date column and the Due sort option.

keys.label: Keep pinned notes visible
keys.doc: Park up to three pinned notes in a strip under the list header so they stay reachable however far the list scrolls.

keys.label: Use the Inbox
keys.doc: Whether Inbox/ is a capture queue: the badge, the fleeting marks and the inbox: search operator. Off, it is just a folder.

keys.label: New notes start in the Inbox
keys.doc: Create new notes in Inbox/ instead of the vault root.

keys.label: Show Inbox notes in the main list
keys.doc: Off, inbox notes only appear through the inbox: operator.

keys.label: Bold list text
keys.doc: Render note titles in the list in bold.

keys.label: Sort by
keys.doc: The list's sort field. Clicking a column header changes it too.

keys.label: Ascending
keys.doc: Sort direction. Names default A→Z, dates newest first, due soonest first.

keys.label: Show tags in the title bar
keys.doc: The open note's tags as chips beside its title.

keys.label: Show folder in the title bar
keys.doc: The open note's subfolder as a chip; only shows for a note in a subfolder.

keys.label: Show the due-date pill
keys.doc: The due-date pill in the title bar.

keys.label: Show link domains as pills
keys.doc: Render a bare URL as a pill labelled with its domain (and any emoji from [domain_emojis]).

keys.label: Ctrl+click to follow links
keys.doc: With it on, a plain click on a link places the cursor; Ctrl+click follows. Off, a plain click follows.

keys.label: Link preview
keys.doc: Alt+click a wiki-link to peek at the target without leaving the note, or off.

keys.label: Plain text mode
keys.doc: Turn live markdown styling off and show the raw text. Also toggled by the togglePlainTextMode shortcut.

keys.label: Show interlinks
keys.doc: The backlinks panel under the note listing every note that links to it.

keys.label: Editor zoom
keys.doc: Scale factor for the editor text; Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 change it too.

keys.label: Word count
keys.doc: The open note's word count in the footer.

keys.label: Character count
keys.doc: The open note's character count in the footer.

keys.label: Note count
keys.doc: The whole vault's note total in the footer.

keys.label: Folder count
keys.doc: The whole vault's folder total in the footer. Only shown when index.include_subfolders is on, since folders do not factor into Envy otherwise.

keys.label: Show a clock in the footer
Date format
keys.doc: short (Tue 2 Sep), medium (2 Sep 2026), full (Tuesday, 2 September 2026), numeric (2026-09-02).

keys.label: Only when full screen
keys.doc: Show the clock only while the window is fullscreen, where the bar is hidden.

keys.label: Start Envy at login
keys.doc: Installs or removes the XDG autostart entry. Rust applies this at launch and whenever it changes.

keys.label: Hide when Envy loses focus
keys.doc: Hide the window when another app takes focus, unless Keep on Top is on.

keys.label: Restore focus when summoned
keys.doc: Put the cursor back where it was (search box or editor) when the window is shown again.

keys.label: Keep on top
keys.doc: Keep the window above others and never hide it on focus loss. On Hyprland this pins the window, which only a floating window can be, so it waits while system.tiled is on. Toggled from the bar icon's menu.

keys.label: Bind Ctrl+Alt+Return in Hyprland
keys.doc: Adds one line to ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua that loads Envy's Hyprland file (the Ctrl+Alt+Return summon, the Ctrl+Alt+C center bind and the floating window rule) and reloads Hyprland; off removes that line again. Only the line Envy added is ever touched: a bind you wrote yourself is left alone, and Envy will not add a second one beside it.

keys.label: Envy is tiled
keys.doc: On Hyprland, tile the main window like any other. Off (the default) it floats as a centered panel. Applied when the window appears and again live when this changes.

keys.label: Pop-out notes are tiled
keys.doc: On Hyprland, tile the windows that Pop Out and Alt+Shift-click open. Off (the default) they float. Applied to each pop-out as it appears and to open ones live when this changes.

keys.label: Theme
keys.doc: omarchy follows the current Omarchy theme; system follows the light/dark preference with the Envious palette; dark and light pin an Envious face. Any other value names a theme file, ~/.config/envy/themes/<value>.md, which overlays the Envious face of its `mode`. In omarchy mode a theme file named after the current Omarchy theme (for example tokyo-night.md) overlays the derived colors automatically.

keys.label: Font
keys.doc: omarchy follows the Omarchy monospace font; custom uses `font_family`.

keys.label: Font family
keys.doc: A fontconfig family name, used when `font` is custom.

keys.label: OpenType features
keys.doc: Comma-separated feature tags applied to all text, for example `ss01`. Empty means automatic: `ss01` for a Cascadia family (its cursive italic letters), nothing for other fonts.

keys.label: Layout
keys.doc: vertical: list above the note. horizontal: list beside it. Also toggled by the toggleLayout shortcut.

keys.label: Interface text size
keys.doc: Scale for the chrome (list, search box, footer). The Settings menu offers the listed steps; any value in range works from the file.

keys.label: Fade the focus highlight
keys.doc: Dim the list selection when the list does not have focus.

keys.label: Import Kindle highlights
keys.doc: Watch for a plugged-in Kindle and offer to import its clippings.

keys.label: Reference in the highlight title
keys.doc: What each imported highlight's title carries besides the book: the page, the Kindle location, both, or neither.

keys.label: Omit the author
keys.doc: Leave the author line out of imported highlights.

keys.label: Omit the location
keys.doc: Leave the Kindle location out of imported highlights.

maps.title: Shortcuts
maps.doc: Overrides for keyboard shortcuts, `id = "Chord"`. Only ids listed in shortcuts.md are valid; an id that is absent keeps its default. Chords are written as fixed-order modifiers plus a key, for example "Ctrl+Alt+N" or "Ctrl+Shift+ArrowDown". The four global ids need a Hyprland bind on Wayland; see the skill.

maps.title: Tag colors
maps.doc: `tagname = "#rrggbb"`. The key is the tag name without its leading #; the value keeps the #. A tag not listed uses the theme's tag color.

maps.title: Folder colors
maps.doc: `"Folder/Sub" = "#rrggbb"` for the subfolder dot and chip. Paths are relative to the vault; quote keys that contain / or spaces.

maps.title: Domain emojis
maps.doc: `"github.com" = "🐙"`, shown on link pills for that domain.

theme_tokens.doc: Keys of a theme file's toml block, ~/.config/envy/themes/<name>.md. Every color is optional: a missing one is filled from the base face (the Omarchy-derived theme in omarchy mode, else Envious dark/light by `mode`). Colors are #rrggbb or #rrggbbaa.

meta.doc: Which Envious face this theme overlays and whether the UI treats it as dark.
Optional fontconfig family; omitted means the appearance.font setting applies.
Optional CSS size for the editor, for example "15px".

colors.doc: A due date that is not close.
A due date within a few days.
A due date in the past.
Inline code and fenced block background.
A vivid accent: the inbox badge.
Note list and search box background.
Blockquote text; also mixed into footer/chrome text.
